description: Hashes a file you choose with SHA-256, SHA-384 or SHA-512 and compares it with a checksum you paste. It reads a plain hash, GNU and BSD checksum lines and whole SHA256SUMS files, and picks the line that matches the file's name. Large files are read in pieces with a progress bar. Everything happens inside the tool window: nothing is stored, uploaded or sent. A match shows the file is the one the checksum was made from, not that the checksum came from the publisher. The tool asks Sanctum for no access at all.

changes.text: Hash a file with SHA-256, SHA-384 or SHA-512 and compare it with a pasted checksum.
Reads plain hashes, GNU and BSD checksum lines and whole SHA256SUMS files, and picks the line that matches the file name.
Files of any size are read in pieces, with a progress bar and a Stop button.
MD5 and SHA-1 sums are recognised and refused, never reported as a match.
First release signed by Enigma Technologies Solutions.

screenshots.alt: Overview of Hash Check: choose a file, paste a checksum and check it.
A file chosen and a SHA256SUMS list pasted, with the algorithm set by the checksum.
A match: the file's SHA-256 equals the pasted checksum, with a Copy hash button.
A mismatch: the number of differing characters and a warning not to use the file.
